title: 2 Things You Didn't Know About the Hennessey Venom F5
description:
The Hennessey Venom F5 is named after a tornado, and its headline horsepower depends on what you pour into the tank. Those are two things most people do not know about America's most extreme hypercar, and a third thing sits behind both of them: the car has never yet shown the three hundred mile per hour top speed it was built to chase. Here are the facts, with every figure sourced. This is the first video in a series on the Venom F5 and its rival, the SSC Tuatara. We will cover the name, the power figures, the production run, the sticker price, the test results, and a crash. We read Wikipedia, evo, The Drive and Motor One. When two numbers disagree, we show both. And where a number is our own arithmetic, we say so.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
